1Password CSV import with one-time passwords.
Source: https://support.1password.com/import-keeper/  ("For 1Password to map one-time passwords correctly, OTPAuth URLs need a
  dedicated column in your CSV file ... label the column with your OTPAuth URLs as 'one-time password'";
  example URL otpauth://totp?secret=...&issuer=&algorithm=SHA1&digits=6&period=30)
Other columns (Title, URL, Username, Password, Notes) are the generic 1Password login CSV headers, per a search-result
summary; support.1password.com/import-csv/ returned HTTP 403 and could not be read.
Retrieved 2026-10-02. Secrets here are made up.
